ng-01.title: Oge NIN-SIM ga-akwusi 30 Sep
ng-01.body: A ga-akwusi ahiri ekwenti ndi ejikoghi na National Identification Number malite 30 September 2026. Ijiko ya bu n'efu. I nwere ike ijiko na outlet nke network gi, site na ikpo koodu NIN nke network, ma o bu site na app NIMC. Ahiri ndi ejikolari adighi mkpa ihe o bula.
ng-01.action: Kpoo *996# (MTN), *121*1# (Airtel) ma o bu gaa outlet network o bula jiri akwukwo NIN gi. Akwula onye o bula ego.

ng-02.title: Oge mkpochi Kano belatara
ng-02.body: Goomenti Kano belatara mkpochi n'obodo Kano na Nassarawa LGA. Mkpochi na-aga ugbu a site na 10pm ruo 5am, kama 7pm ruo 6am, malite Wednesday 16 September. Igaghari n'ezi oge ndi a kwere. Nnyocha nche na-aga n'okporo uzo ndi bu isi.
ng-02.action: Were ID mgbe ochichiri gasiri. Koo mmekpa ahu n'ebe nnyocha na Public Complaints Commission, Kano: 0803 000 0000.

ng-03.title: Ebe nkesa nri Maiduguri akwaga
ng-03.body: Nkesa nri WFP nke onwa maka Bakassi na Teachers Village agbanweela gaa n'ama egwuregwu ulo akwukwo Muna Garage maka Septemba. Nkesa na-aga 18 rue 22 Septemba, 8am rue 3pm. Weta kaadi nri gi. Onweghi ugwo na onweghi ego ndebanye aha.
ng-03.action: Gaa n'ama ulo akwukwo Muna Garage na kaadi nri gi. Onye obula na-acho ego abughi WFP. Kpesa ya na ekwenti efu 0800 500 1000.

ng-04.title: Mkpu mmiri Lagos 19 ruo 21 Sep
ng-04.body: NiMet na-ebu amuma na mmiri ga-ezo nke ukwuu na Lagos site na Fraide 19 ruo Sontag 21 Septemba. Ebe ndi di ala na Ajegunle, Ikorodu, Lekki na Ajah nwere ike ime mkpu mmiri. LASEMA na-adu ndi bi ebe a odu ka ha kpochaa olulu mmiri, bulie ihe ha ji echekwa elu, ma zere iji ugbo ala gafee mmiri guzoro.
ng-04.action: Kpoo LASEMA na 767 ma obu 112 ma o buru na mmiri jidere gi. Gaa ebe di elu ngwa ngwa ma o buru na mmiri rikpuru okporo uzo gi na July.

ng-05.title: Ntuzi aka banyere kolera na steeti 5
ng-05.body: NCDC na-ekwu na oria kolera na-aba uba na Bauchi, Borno, Kano, Lagos na Zamfara. Ihe nrbaama ya bu afo oria mmiri mmiri na agbo. Nuo naani mmiri esiri esi ma o bu nke edoziri, jiri ncha saa aka, sie nri nke oma. Ogwu na ulo ogwu goomenti bu n'efu.
ng-05.action: Malite nu mmiri ogwu oral rehydration salts ozugbo ma gaa ulo ogwu primary health centre kacha nso. NCDC toll free line: 6232.

ng-06.title: Nkparita uka ndi oru ugbo na ndi ozuzu
ng-06.body: Kaduna State Peace Commission ga enwe nkparita uka mepere emepe banyere esemokwu ndi oru ugbo na ndi ozuzu n'ubochi ahia obula na Septemba na ulo oru Kachia na Zangon Kataf LGA. Enwere ike iweta okwu banyere mmebi ihe ubi, uzo eji azu anu na ebe mmiri na-enweghi onye oka iwu.
ng-06.action: Weta aha ndi abuo na ebe ala di. Nkparita uka na-amalite n'elekere 10 nke ututu. Kpoo Commission na 0906 000 0000 maka ubochi.

ng-07.title: Ndebanye aha ntuli aka malite 22 Sep
ng-07.body: INEC na-amalite ndebanye aha ntuli aka na Monde 22 Septemba n'ulo oru LGA niile. Ndi ohuru gbara afo 18 gbagoro, ndi kwagara ebe ozo, na ndi tufuru kaadi ma o bu mebiri emebi nwere ike idebanye aha. Ndebanye aha bu n'efu, o na-ewe ihe dika nkeji 20.
ng-07.action: Gaa n'ulo oru INEC LGA gi were akwukwo njirimara o bula gosiri ubochi omumu gi. O dighi ugwo o bula.

ng-09.title: Jos: nzuko udo obodo Satode
ng-09.body: Plateau Peace Building Agency na-akpo nzuko obodo maka ward Jos North na Satode 20 Septemba na ulo nzuko Jos North LGA, elekere 10 nke ututu. Nzuko a ga-ekwu okwu banyere esemokwu ala na Angwan Rukuba na ikwenye otu esi eji ahia Farin Gada.
ng-09.action: Ndi isi ward na ndi isi ntorobia kwesiri ibia. Onye obula nwere ike izipu nsogbu ya tupu oge site na nhoro akuko na line a.

ke-01.title: Kaadi ID ohuru: otu esi etinye akwukwo
ke-01.body: Ministry of Interior na-eweputa kaadi ID ohuru na Huduma Centres niile na ulo oru ndebanye aha. Onye mbu gbara afo 18 choro akwukwo omumu na ID nne ma obu nna. Idochi kaadi furu efu na-eri KSh 300. O na-ewe ihe dika ubochi 14.
ke-01.action: Gaa Huduma Centre kacha nso gi. Soro kaadi gi site na *232#. Akwula ndi ozo ego.

ke-03.title: Ntuli aka mmefu ego Nairobi
ke-03.body: Nairobi County na-eme nzuko ndi mmadu banyere mmefu ego mgbakwunye 2026/27 na sub-county 17 nile site na 18 rue 23 Septemba. Ndi bi nwere ike juo ajuju banyere mmefu na mmiri, uzo na ahu ike ma tuwa aro mgbanwe. A na-anabata akwukwo edere ede.
ke-03.action: Gaa nzuko sub-county gi n'ulo oru sub-county, elekere 9 nke ututu. Ma obu ziga uche gi na county assembly clerk tupu 23 Septemba.

cd-01.title: Goma: mbuga Bulengo na-akwaga
cd-01.body: OCHA na UNHCR kwuru na ezinulo no na Bulengo ga-enwe ohere ikwaga na Sake site na 20 Septemba. Ugboala na ngwa nloghachi di n'efu. O nweghi onye a manyere ikwaga, nri na-aga n'ihu na Bulengo rue ogwugwu Septemba.
cd-01.action: Gwa komiti mbuga ma o bu ndi UNHCR no n'onu uzo mbuga. Akwula onye obula ego maka oche n'ugboala.

sd-01.title: Mgbasa Ogbugba Ogwu Cholera
sd-01.body: Ndi Federal Ministry of Health na WHO na-eme mgbasa ogbugba ogwu cholera n'onu na Gezira, Khartoum na Red Sea states site na 18 rue 25 September. Ogwu a bu n'efu maka onye obula kariri otu afo. NdI otu ga-aru oru site na health centres, ulo alakuba na ahia.
sd-01.action: Gaa na health centre kacha nso ma obu gee maka ozi ndi otu na-aga ebe niile. Otu ogwu ezuru maka mgbasa a.

mz-01.title: Cabo Delgado: nloghachi na nkwado
mz-01.body: IOM na-ako na ezinulo na-alaghachi na Mocimboa da Praia na Macomia nwere ike idebanye aha maka ngwugwu nloghachi: ihe eji ewu ulo na nri onwa ato. Ndebanye aha na ulo oru nchikwa district. Uzo gaa Macomia mepere emepe, ma juo ndi nchikwa obodo tupu njem.
mz-01.action: Debanye aha na ulo oru nchikwa district na kaadi mgbapu gi. Enyemaka bu n'efu. Kpoo Linha Verde 1458 ikpesa nsogbu.

ng-08.title: Ogwu ntiwapuu n'efu na FCT 22-28 Sep
ng-08.body: Ebe nile a na-enye nlekota ahu na kansul isii nke FCT ga-enye umuaka ndi gbara afo 9 ruo 5 ogwu ntiwapuu na rubella n'efu site na 22 ruo 28 September. O dighi kaadi ma obu oge acho. Nd i otu ogwu ga-eletakwa ahia na ulo akwukwo.
ng-08.action: Kpuru nwa gi n'ebe obula a na-enye nlekota ahu n'etiti elekere 8 nke ututu na 4 nke ehihie. Were kaadi ogwu nwa gi ma i nwere ya.

ke-02.title: Ndebanye aha enyemaka oke ohia Turkana
ke-02.body: National Drought Management Authority na-edebanye aha ezinulo na Turkana Central, Loima na Turkana North maka enyemaka ego nke September rue November. Ndebanye aha na-eme n'ulo oru ward site na 17 rue 24 September. Ezinulo edebanyere aha na-enweta KSh 5,400 kwa onwa site na M-Pesa.
ke-02.action: Gaa n'ulo oru ward gi na ID gi na ID nke otu onye okenye ozo n'ezinulo gi. Ndebanye aha bu n'efu.
